English.FI.DESC_DURATION_MULT:
Fuel burn time multiplier.
1.0 = no change | 1.5 = 50% longer | 2.0 = twice as long.
Affects all fuel: wood, coal, accelerant.
English.FI.DESC_MAX_DURATION:
Maximum possible fire burn time in hours.
12 = vanilla (no change)
24 = one day | 72 = three days | 120 = five days | 200 = eight days.
English.FI.DESC_WIND_RESIST:
Chance (%) that wind does NOT blow out the fire.
0 = no protection (vanilla)
50 = fire goes out half as often
100 = wind never extinguishes fire.
English.FI.DESC_START_BONUS:
Flat bonus added to fire start success chance.
Added after all skill, tool and weather calculations.
0 = no change | 15 = +15% to success.
English.FI.DESC_INDOOR_WARMTH:
Extra warmth from fire indoors (stoves, fireplaces).
0 = no change | 5 = +5°C to minimum air temperature from fire.
English.FI.DESC_OUTDOOR_WARMTH:
Extra warmth from fire outdoors (campfires).
0 = no change | 3 = +3°C to minimum air temperature from fire.
